What a powerful act of love.

Video

Once again, the Trump administration has chosen to stand with powerful corporations over the health and safety of the American people.

Now they’re gutting regulations that protect us from forever-chemicals linked to cancer being dumped into our drinking water. Mega-corporations get to pollute, while our children, our families, and our communities pay the price.

op: @drjessicaknurick

Video

The proof is in the data.

Video

Donald Trump’s reckless wars, chaotic tariffs, and cruel cuts to essential services aren’t just squeezing families right now—they’re driving up the debt for generations to come.

Thanks @adammockler for laying it plain.

Video

“Talent is insignificant., I know a lot of talented ruins. Beyond talent lie all the usual words: Discipline, Love, Luck, but most of all, Endurance.” - James Baldwin

Video

This President is a disaster for everyone, except for his own bank account.

Video

This is awesome.

Video

Trading stocks should be illegal for all elected politicians, especially the president.

This is yet another clear example of Trump’s blatant corruption.

Donald Trump is committing one of the most brazen and corrupt acts in modern presidential history. He and his inner circle are shamelessly enriching themselves with taxpayer dollars, while working families are being crushed by skyrocketing prices.

We must call out not only this corruption, but the enablers and the silent Members of Congress who are complicit in this theft from the American people. We will not be silent.

Video

Working families are already paying the price for Trump’s chaos and corruption, but now he is taking it even further. The $1.8 billion Trump slush fund–with no congressional oversight or accountability, entirely from taxpayer dollars–is a ripe opportunity for corruption.

We must demand answers on this obvious and unprecedented grift. 

op: @secupp

Video

Since the start of this conflict I have done everything I can to rein in this President and end his reckless war. Americans have demanded accountability and finally the dam may be  breaking. We must keep standing up and speaking out to demand an end to the war in Iran.

Video

6 Words. This story may be apocryphal but I’ve always enjoyed it. May we be kind to one another even and especially amidst the awful, stress, and hassle of air travel (or life in general).

Video

Yes–go Cruz!

There is a quiet emergency in America making us sicker and poorer.

Sicker because the food we are feeding our families is driving a chronic disease epidemic.

Poorer because a handful of mega-corporations are driving up the costs of groceries, insurance, and prescription drugs for diseases they shouldn’t have gotten in the first place.

Video

Now is once again the time to get into some good trouble.

Beautiful graphic by @heatherschiderillustrates_

This slush fund for Trump allies, potentially including January 6th rioters, is a gross misuse of taxpayer dollars. Unfortunately, we know congressional Republicans will provide no oversight or accountability, letting Trump and his allies fleece our government for millions.

op: @aaronparnas

Video

The Supreme Court ruling did not just eviscerate the Voting Rights Act, it was a desecration of the martyrs who struggled and fought for fairness and representation.

We must not stand for it. We must rise with a chorus of conviction and demand a government that truly represents every single one of us.
